title: bounded-autonomy: Containing and Unwinding the Blast Radius of Agentic Workflows
description: Proof-of-concept measurement rig for the Bounded Autonomy paper: a one-node k3d cluster that evaluates per-task network segmentation, SPIFFE identity, and task-keyed lineage on a long-running multi-step agent workload. ICSA revision (tag v1.1-icsa-submission): profile long-multistep, modes flat and full, ten seeds, median [IQR] tables, plus gateway, sweep, evasion, re-declaration, and data-intensive cells. Four metric exporters (reach, credentials, rollback, overhead). This software artefact supplements the Paper 1 preprint.
